title: Sulfonyl-bridged oligo(benzoic acid)s: synthesis, X-ray structures, and properties as metal extractants

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Tb4L4(H2O)6](Et3NH)4 · CH2Cl2 · 3(Et2O) · nH2O (L = fully deprotonated 7_4; crystallographic C213H300Cl2N4O69S12Tb4)

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear terbium(III) carboxylato cluster of sulfonyl-bridged tetrabenzoate 7_4

synthesis.procedure: To a solution of 7_4 (23.0 mg, 25.0 μmol) in methanol–toluene (4:1, 20.0 mL) was added Et3N (d = 0.729; 69 μL, 0.50 mmol), and the mixture was stirred for 30 min. A solution of Tb(NO3)3·6H2O (11.0 mg, 25.0 μmol) in methanol–toluene (4:1, 5.0 mL) was added, and the mixture was refluxed for 3 h. Volatiles were evaporated; the residue was dissolved in CHCl3 (10 mL) and washed with water (10 mL × 2). After evaporation of the organic layer, crystallization from CH2Cl2–hexane gave 11 (17.0 mg, 59%) as a colorless powder. Single crystals were obtained by vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into a CH2Cl2 solution of 11.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (after 30 min stirring at unspecified temperature); crystallization not temperature-specified
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under reflux; workup by evaporation and aqueous wash; crystallization from CH2Cl2–hexane; single crystals by Et2O vapor diffusion into CH2Cl2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation of volatiles; residue dissolved in CHCl3 (10 mL) and washed with water (10 mL × 2); organic layer evaporated; crystallized from CH2Cl2–hexane to a colorless powder. Single crystals by vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into a CH2Cl2 solution.
